subject: Hand‑carry playbook and last‑mile plan for Crestwave exec workshop
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kerry O'Neill <kerry.oneill@crestwave.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-29T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Hand‑carry playbook and last‑mile plan for Crestwave exec workshop

Kerry —

Thanks again for making time for the executive workshop on Dec 8. Per our prep call, we’re planning to hand‑carry the demo laptop, two external GPUs (in soft cases), and the printed leader packets to avoid customs delays. I put together a short playbook and packing list attached (packing_list_Crestwave_1.0.pdf) plus the draft hand‑carry manifest.

Key asks for you:
- Confirm the venue loading dock window on Dec 8 between 07:30–08:15 — we’ll need direct access for credentialed staff.
- Can your on‑site events lead (or security) sign the attached temporary customs CDA so we can clear the hand‑carry items on arrival? I’ve included a fillable version (customs_cda_signed.pdf) for signature.

Operational notes:
- All tech will be in soft cases; batteries removed and in carry‑on per airline rules. No lithium packs in checked.
- Total declared value for customs is listed in the manifest. We’ll provide a paper copy to venue security and to the courier manifest in case a last‑minute handoff is needed.

I’m traveling from SFO on the 8th morning and will be the designated hand‑carry. Lauren will be the account lead on logistics and Rishi will be on escalation standby.

Attaching: packing_list_Crestwave_1.0.pdf, handcarry_manifest_v3.xlsx, customs_cda_signed.pdf

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Kerry O'Neill <kerry.oneill@crestwave.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Venue Contact <events@thecalibrehall.com>, Logistics Ops <ops@swiftfreight.co>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hand‑carry playbook and last‑mile plan for Crestwave exec workshop

Ben —

Thanks for the detailed note and attachments. Loading dock window confirmed: Dec 8, 07:45–08:30. I copied our venue contact and the local courier in case you need assistance for pre‑clearance.

On the customs CDA: I’m happy to sign and return. Quick question — can you add the model numbers of the GPUs to the manifest (we need them listed for our internal asset team)?

Also, we’d like a single labeled box of printed leader packets left with our registration desk (we’ll accept the rest at the demo table). Can you confirm the dimension/weight so we can pre‑reserve a small storage crate?

Kerry O'Neill
Head of Global Events
Crestwave Systems
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Kerry O'Neill <kerry.oneill@crestwave.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-30T08:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hand‑carry playbook and last‑mile plan for Crestwave exec workshop

Kerry —

Thanks — I updated the manifest (handcarry_manifest_v3.xlsx) to include GPU serials and model numbers (A100‑40GB x2, serials masked in the attached). Packing list includes one labeled box: "Leader Packets — Registration" (dimensions 14x10x6 in, approx 8 lb).

Quick operational items for my team:
- Ben: bring venue sign‑in badge for on‑site crew (we’ll supply printed badges at the security kiosk).
- Ben/Rishi: if SwiftFreight can’t accommodate a last‑minute handoff, plan to drop the leader packets with the registration desk before the 08:45 attendee arrival.

I’ve attached the venue drop‑off map (venue_dropoff_map_calibre.png) and a one‑page hand‑carry checklist.

Lauren Bishop
Logistics Lead, Enterprise Field Programs
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kerry O'Neill <kerry.oneill@crestwave.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-12-01T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Hand‑carry playbook and last‑mile plan for Crestwave exec workshop

All —

Confirmed plans below and closing the loop:
1) Loading dock: Dec 8, 07:45–08:30 (venue contact on copy).
2) Manifest: latest version uploaded to Drive; includes GPU model numbers (A100‑40GB x2) and serial reference numbers per Lauren’s update.
3) Customs CDA: Kerry — thanks for offering to sign. Please return the signed PDF to ops@swiftfreight.co and cc me. We’ll carry an additional paper copy in case security asks.
4) Leader packets: one labeled box to be left with registration (14x10x6 in, 8 lb). Lauren — please provide printed badge for my crew at the security kiosk.
5) Contingency: if there’s an unexpected hold with SwiftFreight, I will hand‑carry the packets to the registration desk and our venue lead will accept them. Rishi — please stand by for escalation between 06:30–09:30 PT on Dec 8.

Attachments again for quick reference: handcarry_manifest_v3.xlsx, packing_list_Crestwave_1.0.pdf, venue_dropoff_map_calibre.png

See you on site — traveling light.
